title: Private audit logging parity checklist (installer/upgrade actions → audit events)
body:
Purpose
- Ensure Redwood Private has equivalent audit logging coverage to Hosted/Dedicated for sensitive operator actions performed via the private installer/upgrade tooling.
- This checklist is used as the implementation guide for ENG-4826 and as the parity sign-off artifact for PM-938.

Scope
- Tooling in scope: redwood-private-installer (CLI + embedded upgrade/rollback logic + config apply + credential lifecycle + export config helpers).
- Environments: VPC-based Private and on-prem/air-gapped Private.
- What this is NOT: a UI/console audit checklist (see Console admin workflows doc); this is strictly installer/operator executed actions.

Assumptions / conventions
- Canonical schema: Audit event schema v1.
- event_type naming: dot-separated, low-cardinality. No customer-provided strings in event_type.
- Required core fields must be populated for every event: schema_version, event_id, occurred_at, event_type, outcome, actor.* (as available), tenant_id (if known), deployment_mode=private, environment identifiers, correlation IDs.
- "Operator identity" in Private can be incomplete. Preferred order:
  1) SSO identity if installer authenticates via SAML/OIDC to a Private control plane
  2) Installer-supplied operator_email/operator_id flags (validated where possible)
  3) Host identity (machine user / CI service account) + source IP (or node IP)
  4) If none: actor.type=system with actor.display="unknown-operator" AND include actor_attribution="unverified".
- Do NOT emit secrets (tokens, kubeconfigs, private keys). For credential operations, capture credential_id / key_fingerprint / last4 where applicable.

Implementation notes (where to instrument)
- Emit at command boundary (start + completion) for long-running operations, and at sub-step boundary for sensitive irreversible changes.
- For idempotent commands that can be re-run, emit event_id as ULID/UUID at the start and re-use it for completion to aid dedupe/correlation.
- For retries, keep at-least-once semantics. Customers should dedupe using event_id (and optionally (event_type, occurred_at, deployment_id) for legacy).
- Correlation:
  - request_id: CLI invocation ID (stable for the command)
  - admin_action_id: same as request_id for installer-driven actions (unless the installer triggers multiple admin actions)
  - trace_id: if OpenTelemetry tracing is wired in (nice-to-have; not a hard dependency)

Parity checklist (actions → event types → where to instrument)

Legend
- Cmd: installer CLI command / entrypoint
- Location: module/function (approximate) where event emission should live
- Minimum target fields: what MUST be present beyond core schema fields

A) Install lifecycle
1) Fresh install started
- Sensitive? Yes (provisions control plane + credentials + endpoints)
- event_type: private.installer.install.started
- Cmd: rw-private install
- Location: cmd/install.go:Run() before preflight begins
- Minimum target fields:
  - target.type=private_deployment
  - target.id=deployment_id (generated early)
  - target.name=cluster_name (bounded)
  - metadata.install_mode=standard|airgapped
  - metadata.version.target=<installer_version>

2) Fresh install completed
- event_type: private.installer.install.completed
- Cmd: rw-private install
- Location: cmd/install.go:Run() on successful completion
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.duration_ms
  - metadata.components_enabled (allow-list values only)

3) Fresh install failed
- event_type: private.installer.install.failed
- Cmd: rw-private install
- Location: cmd/install.go:Run() in top-level error handler
- Minimum target fields:
  - outcome=failure
  - error.code (enum)
  - error.message (truncated; no secrets)

4) Preflight checks overridden / bypassed
- Sensitive? Yes (weakens safety posture)
- event_type: private.installer.preflight.override
- Cmd: rw-private install --skip-preflight / --force
- Location: cmd/common/preflight.go where override flag is parsed/applied
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.overrides=["skip_preflight", ...]
  - metadata.reason (optional, capped length)

B) Upgrade / rollback lifecycle
5) Upgrade started
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.installer.upgrade.started
- Cmd: rw-private upgrade
- Location: cmd/upgrade.go:Run() before any mutations
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.version.from
  - metadata.version.to
  - metadata.channel=stable|hotfix|custom

6) Upgrade completed
- event_type: private.installer.upgrade.completed
- Cmd: rw-private upgrade
- Location: cmd/upgrade.go:Run() success
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.duration_ms
  - metadata.migrations_applied_count

7) Upgrade failed
- event_type: private.installer.upgrade.failed
- Cmd: rw-private upgrade
- Location: cmd/upgrade.go:Run() error handler
- Minimum target fields:
  - outcome=failure
  - error.code (enum)

8) Rollback started
- Sensitive? Yes (may revert security patches)
- event_type: private.installer.rollback.started
- Cmd: rw-private rollback
- Location: cmd/rollback.go:Run() start
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.version.from
  - metadata.version.to
  - metadata.rollback_reason (optional, capped)

9) Rollback completed
- event_type: private.installer.rollback.completed
- Cmd: rw-private rollback
- Location: cmd/rollback.go:Run() success

10) Rollback failed
- event_type: private.installer.rollback.failed
- Cmd: rw-private rollback
- Location: cmd/rollback.go:Run() error handler

C) Configuration changes (apply/patch)
11) Apply config (any change)
- Sensitive? Yes (can change auth, routing, export endpoints)
- event_type: private.installer.config.apply
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config / rw-private configure
- Location: cmd/apply_config.go after diff is computed and before apply
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.config_scope=global|control_plane|data_plane|exporter
  - diff.summary (bounded, machine-generated)
  - diff.fields_changed=["rbac.default_role", "network.egress_proxy", ...] (allow-list preferred)
  - metadata.requires_restart=true|false

12) Config apply failed
- event_type: private.installer.config.apply_failed
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: cmd/apply_config.go error handler
- Minimum target fields:
  - outcome=failure
  - error.code

13) Data residency / region pinning changed (Private)
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.data_residency.settings.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/residency.go where values validated and persisted
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.scope=tenant|project|deployment
  - change.before (redacted)
  - change.after (redacted)

14) Retention settings changed (audit logs, traces, metrics)
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.retention.settings.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/retention.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.settings=["audit_logs", "traces"]
  - change.before / change.after (numerical values only)

D) Credential and access operations
15) Rotate Private control plane admin credential
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.credentials.rotated
- Cmd: rw-private rotate-credentials --type=admin
- Location: cmd/rotate_credentials.go and underlying secret writer
- Minimum target fields:
  - target.type=credential
  - target.id=credential_id (NOT the secret)
  - metadata.credential_type=admin
  - metadata.rotation_reason (optional)

16) Rotate TLS certificates (ingress / internal mTLS)
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.tls.certificates.rotated
- Cmd: rw-private rotate-credentials --type=tls
- Location: cmd/rotate_credentials.go + cert manager integration
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.cert_scope=ingress|internal|exporter
  - metadata.fingerprint_before / fingerprint_after (hash only)

17) KMS/HSM integration configured or changed
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.kms.settings.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/kms.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.kms_provider=aws_kms|gcp_kms|azure_kv|hsm
  - change.before / change.after (no key material, ARNs redacted to account-only if needed)

18) Break-glass / emergency access enabled/disabled
- Sensitive? Yes (high risk)
- event_type: private.break_glass.access.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/security_overrides.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.enabled=true|false
  - metadata.expiry_at (required if enabled)
  - metadata.ticket_ref (optional)

E) Audit log export configuration (Private)
19) Configure SIEM export destination
- Sensitive? Yes (data exfil vector)
- event_type: private.audit_export.destination.updated
- Cmd: rw-private configure-export / apply-config exporter section
- Location: exporter/config.go after validation, before persist
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.export_target=splunk_hec|azure_sentinel|datadog|generic_https|s3
  - metadata.endpoint_host (host only; no path/query; redact if needed)
  - metadata.tls_verify=true|false
  - change.before / change.after (redacted)

20) Enable/disable audit export
- event_type: private.audit_export.state.updated
- Cmd: rw-private configure-export --enabled=true|false
- Location: exporter/config.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.enabled=true|false

21) Rotate export auth (tokens/keys)
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.audit_export.credentials.rotated
- Cmd: rw-private configure-export --rotate-auth
- Location: exporter/secrets.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - target.type=credential
  - target.id=export_credential_id
  - metadata.export_target=...

F) Network / egress / proxy changes
22) Egress proxy settings updated
- Sensitive? Yes (impacts where logs and traffic can go)
- event_type: private.network.egress_proxy.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/network.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - change.before / change.after (host/port only; redact credentials)

23) Allowed outbound destinations / allow-lists updated
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.network.allowlist.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config
- Location: config/network_policy.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.list_type=domain|ip|cidr
  - metadata.operation=add|remove|replace
  - metadata.count_delta (preferred) OR values hashed (if needed)

G) Runtime / policy surfaces triggered by installer (Private-only touches)
24) Enable/disable models at deployment level (if installer manages catalog)
- Sensitive? Yes (capabilities change)
- event_type: private.runtime.models.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config (models section)
- Location: config/models.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.operation=enable|disable|pin_version
  - target.type=model
  - target.id=model_id

25) Routing/fallback policy updates (if managed in Private)
- Sensitive? Yes
- event_type: private.routing.policy.updated
- Cmd: rw-private apply-config (routing/policy section)
- Location: config/routing.go
- Minimum target fields:
  - diff.summary
  - metadata.policy_scope=deployment|tenant

H) Uninstall / decommission
26) Decommission started
- Sensitive? Yes (data deletion + outage)
- event_type: private.installer.decommission.started
- Cmd: rw-private decommission
- Location: cmd/decommission.go:Run() start
- Minimum target fields:
  - metadata.confirmation=explicit (ensure this is only emitted after user confirms)

27) Decommission completed
- event_type: private.installer.decommission.completed
- Cmd: rw-private decommission
- Location: cmd/decommission.go success

28) Decommission failed
- event_type: private.installer.decommission.failed
- Cmd: rw-private decommission
- Location: cmd/decommission.go error handler

Fields checklist (Private-specific)
- deployment_mode must be "private" for all installer-produced events.
- deployment_id should be stable across the lifetime of the Private environment.
- cluster_id/k8s_context should be captured if available, but do not leak kubeconfig contents.
- source.ip: best effort; in on-prem this may be the bastion or node. If unknown, omit rather than guess.

Redaction / safety notes
- Never log:
  - kubeconfig, bearer tokens, client secrets, TLS private keys
  - full endpoint URLs that may contain tokens/query params
  - full diff of configuration files (only summarize + list changed fields)
- OK to log:
  - versions, timestamps, high-level flags, hashed fingerprints, hostnames (if approved by redaction policy)

Test/verification checklist (acceptance criteria)
- For each command above:
  - Emit at least one audit event with schema_version=v1.
  - Validate event against schema locally (unit test) and in e2e harness (ENG-4834 where applicable).
  - Ensure event_type is registered (ENG-4822 registry) and not a one-off.
  - Confirm outcome is set correctly on failure paths.
  - Confirm correlation IDs: request_id present and stable for start/completion pairs.

Known gaps / open questions (as of 2026-02-19)
- Operator identity: do we want a required installer flag --operator-email for enterprise customers, or keep optional? (Vivek + Marcus to decide; impacts schema requiredness for actor fields in Private.)
- Air-gapped environments: if export is configured to write to local file, should we treat file-path as sensitive and only log destination_type=local_file? (Recommend yes; do not emit full paths.)
- Rollback semantics: if rollback is automated (health-check triggers), do we emit actor.type=system with actor.display="auto-rollback"? (Proposed.)

Next steps
- Implement instrumentation in private-installer per PR-611 plan and verify against this checklist.
- Validate with a Private customer reproduction of SUP-18421 (missing RBAC events were symptom; installer events must be present regardless).
- Provide parity sign-off summary to Naomi/Olga: list of event_types shipped + sample redacted payloads + link to coverage dashboard screenshot when available.
